workResult: Skill 03 completed source-bounded Deep Reading for all three same-date Selected objects. Q-20260907-01 read the complete 197-work multi-agent security systematization and its 44-work evaluation audit. The source models security around cross-principal end-to-end A-I-R executions, six interaction interfaces and eight recurring attack paths, and evaluates defenses through path target, observation, intervention, trust boundary and recovery. It explicitly shows that local protection does not establish path closure and that containment is not recovery once influence has propagated into shared state, artifacts, credentials, delegated authority or spawned principals. The bounded runtime finding is that individually safe workers cannot by themselves prove system safety; an authority-to-effect chain needs end-to-end provenance, observable intervention points, declared trust assumptions, alternate-path closure checks and recovery evidence. Q-20260907-02 read the complete 100-agent autonomous research-swarm case study across setup, exploit propagation, normative response and governance discussion. One exploit spread through shared knowledge and peer messages while the same transparent channels enabled independent auditing, public/private warnings, boycotts, complaints and remediation proposals. Those responses could not halt the exploit because the complaint channel was unmonitored in real time and peers lacked binding dispute, removal and sanction tools. The bounded architecture finding separates observability and normative judgment from complaint intake, adjudication/conflict resolution, sanction/remediation execution and rule-change authority. Q-20260907-03 read the complete Harness-of-Harness primary study across architecture, state model, benchmark protocol and multi-day case. Planning, development and QA are separate role invocations; artifact state and evidence state are carried independently across loops; acceptance is based on observations of a fixed candidate rather than the implementing claim. Across GameCraft-Bench, FrontierSWE and ProgramBench, the reported three harness-model pairs achieve an average 52.25% relative gain after three iterations; the multi-day game case retains versioned GitHub/issue/evidence history and shows reopened defects after later regressions. The bounded engineering finding is that a context window is disposable but project truth is not: long-horizon work needs stable candidate identity, durable evidence continuity, freshness after change and independent acceptance. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication. Validate Research Center 3.0 run 34079151212 successfully completed its Runtime Center validation on the exact three-note head 0a58e8cce7e7cf4571481cc9f456659b5b36f2bb before terminal finalization.
